events.text: Root cause isolated in framework/gpu/3d.zig: face loop-cut derives its planes from the selected part but meshLoopCutFacePreview passes the entire resident soup to planeCutSoup, so every crossing outliner part is split. Fix will enforce a per-input-face mutation mask in the pure topology boundary and propagate it across multi-plane previews.
Verified: zig build test-mesh-edit passes, including the two-part crossing-plane regression; SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor completes in ReleaseFast. Commit b32b2409d.

resolution: Fixed loop-cut isolation in the native mesh editor by adding a strict per-face mutation mask and carrying the active outliner scope through every preview plane. Face-popup and edge loop cuts now leave sibling parts untouched, with a Zig regression covering two parts crossed by the same plane. Verified by the targeted native test and a full ReleaseFast editor build.
